_meta.purpose: Takashi Kiyohara firsthand-confirmed articles として baseline、ESL personal mean+σ 引算で E 軸 (AI fingerprint) FP 低減

calibration_method.step_1: Read 5 baseline articles, extract sectionStrip'd content body
calibration_method.step_2: Compute mean (μ) + stddev (σ) of each metric across the 5 corpus
calibration_method.step_3: For each new article: z = (metric_value - μ) / σ
calibration_method.step_4: compositePass: z_em_dash < 2 AND z_boilerplate < 2 AND z_sentlen_var > -2 (Draft 2 formula = base)
calibration_method.step_5_active: Draft 3 P-4 圧縮版 (active): GPTZero 2nd opinion 範囲 = suspect 15% only (z in [2,3) for em_dash/boilerplate, or z in (-3,-2] for sentlen_var)。step_4 fail かつ Z 範囲 [2,3) のみ GPTZero call、(3,inf) は確定 fail。
calibration_method.step_5_draft2_legacy: Draft 2 (legacy、do NOT use): GPTZero suspect 30% (z in [2,inf))、free tier 予算超過リスク

notes: Article 集合は Takashi 実訪問 / R11 動画 firsthand 5 本 (handoff doc Section 7 PRESERVE LIST Tier 1 + W5 SHIP Round 3 確定)
